title: Humming Adventure

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Let’s hum together and see what the walls do!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: I think the stone will dance if we try again.

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four—listen to the gentle echo!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: It’s getting brighter each time we keep trying!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Patience makes the hum turn into sparkling light!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: We’ll share this bright song with everyone tomorrow!
